declarations.description:
Live bids and asks with depth bars, price grouping and a spread row, like the order books of Binance, Coinbase
Advanced and Kraken Pro. Bids are drawn high to low and asks low to high; each row shows the size at its price and
the cumulative total from the best price, with a bar sized by that total behind it.

`bids` and `asks` take a snapshot (`{ price, size }` objects or the `[price, size]` pairs exchange feeds send, as
numbers or numeric strings); `applyDelta()` patches it from a stream, a size of 0 removing a level. Only `depth`
levels a side are drawn, so a deep book renders as cheaply as a shallow one. A level whose size changes flashes
green when it grew and red when it shrank (not under `prefers-reduced-motion`).

`layout` stacks the asks over the bids with the spread between them, or sets them side by side. `group` merges levels
into price steps (bids round down, asks round up), and `groups` lists the steps the reader may pick in the header.
`last-price` puts the last trade in the spread row instead of the mid price, and `own-prices` marks the prices the
user has orders at.

Clicking a row, or pressing Enter on it, fires `price-select`: the hook for filling a trade form. The rows share one
tab stop, and the arrow keys move between them. Each side is a table, so a screen reader reads its columns; the
spread row is not a live region, since a live book would never stop talking.

members.name: bids
members.description: The buy side, best first or in any order: a snapshot that replaces the bids.

members.name: asks
members.description: The sell side, in any order: a snapshot that replaces the asks.

members.name: layout
members.description: Asks over bids with the spread between (`stacked`), or bids and asks side by side (`split`).

members.name: depth
members.description: Levels drawn on each side.

members.name: group
members.description: The price step levels are merged into: bids round down to it, asks round up. 0 shows every price.

members.name: groups
members.description: Price steps the reader may pick from in the header, as a `;` list (`"0.01;0.1;1;10"`).

members.name: base
members.description: The traded asset, for the size header: "Size (BTC)".

members.name: quote
members.description: The pricing asset, for the price header: "Price (USD)".

members.name: pricePrecision
members.description: Fraction digits of prices. Without it: the group step's, else the most the data has.

members.name: sizePrecision
members.description: Fraction digits of sizes and totals.

members.name: lastPrice
members.description: The last trade price, shown in the spread row with an arrow against the previous one. Without it: the mid price.

members.name: ownPrices
members.description: Prices the user has orders at, as a `;` list: each gets a dot.

members.name: label
members.description: The heading and accessible name.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows a spinner and "Waiting for the book…" while the book is empty.

members.name: locale
members.description: The locale numbers are formatted in. Without it: the nearest `lang`.

members.name: levels
members.default: { bid: new Map(), ask: new Map() }

members.name: dataDigits
members.description: Fraction digits the data itself carries, for prices.

members.name: shown
members.description: The sizes drawn last time, to tell which levels changed.

members.name: flashes
members.description: Each changed level's flash class, alternating between two names so a second change replays the animation.

members.name: focusKey
members.description: The row holding the tab stop.

members.name: applyDelta
members.description:
Patches the book from a stream: each level sets the size at its price, and a size of 0 removes it. Several deltas
in one task are drawn in one render.

members.name: levelsOf
members.description: The levels drawn on a side, best first, after grouping.

members.name: track
members.description: Sizes the depth bars against the deepest total drawn, and flashes the levels whose size changed.

members.name: stopInner
members.description: The select inside fires `input`/`change` and enrols in a field: none of that is the book's.

events.name: price-select

type.text: CustomEvent<{ side: 'bid' | 'ask'; price: number; size: number; total: number }>

events.description: Fired when a row is clicked or Enter is pressed on it. Does not bubble.

events.name: group-change
events.description: Fired when the reader picks a price step in the header. Does not bubble.
